description.en: A self-hosted format-1 index containing the 小说模式 (Novel Mode) plugin.
description.zh: 自托管的 format-1 索引，收录「小说模式」插件。

description.en: From one idea to a finished, consistency-checked novel: a deterministic writing ENGINE for DeepSeek Harness, not a prompt pack. A JavaScript state machine owns 7 script-gated stages plus a 15-step serial per-chapter sub-FSM; PowerShell validators decide every gate, versioned atomic checkpoints resume at the exact chapter, 9 subagent workers are evidence-adjudicated in code, and the user sees only quiet structured status with zero prompt dumps, leaked errors or bundled credentials.
description.zh: 一个想法到一本校验通过的小说：DeepSeek Harness 的确定性写作引擎，不是提示词包。JavaScript 状态机掌握 7 个脚本硬门禁阶段与 15 步串行单章子状态机，版本化原子断点精确续写，9 个子代理由代码按证据裁决，用户只看到安静的结构化状态：无提示词、无错误外泄、零内置凭据。

_notes: This is a COMPLETE format-1 index whose plugins[] holds exactly ONE plugin object — directly hostable, no placeholders left. DSH ignores unknown top-level members, so you may delete this _notes field before hosting.

WHERE TO HOST: serve this file from any static host — GitHub Pages (e.g. https://github-yousen.github.io/dsh-novel-mode/index.json from a gh-pages branch or /docs), GitLab Pages, or an object store. Requirements: https, 2xx status, NO redirects, <=128 MiB, URL contains NO '# fragment' and NO user/password. A relative icon resolves against the index URL.
source.commit is the real 40-hex SHA of the pushed plugin commit; publishTimestamp is its real Unix push time (2026-11-09). DSH installs a git version as git+<url>.git#<commit>.

HOW USERS FIND IT: this is the READ/Discover side, NOT the official submission channel (that is the awesome-dsh-plugin data/plugins/*.yml PR). On dsh 0.2.1+ the user must enable the experimental 'Custom plugin indexes' bundle, then go to Plugins -> Discover -> Index sources -> Add index source and paste the hosted URL. It is per-profile volatile config (setIndexes), ~10 min cache, 15 s fetch timeout, indexes are unsigned — add only trusted sources.
engines.dsh is copied verbatim from the plugin's package.json; the host re-checks it on install.

icon is intentionally omitted (optional). If added, use an inline base64 data: URL (<=32 KiB, SVG/PNG/JPEG/WebP) or a relative/https URL; note the CATALOG tile (contributing.md) refuses SVG, but the format-1 index icon does allow SVG.
